name: DATEV Online APIs Sandbox
description: Sandbox DATEV connector covering accounting-clients, accounting-documents (Belegbilderservice), and accounting-dataexchange (Datenservice Export Rechnungswesen) from DATEV's Online APIs.
instructions:
**Important — this connector is NOT plug-and-play.** DATEV's Online APIs require:

1. A registered sandbox app on the DATEV-Entwicklerportal (https://developer.datev.de) → **Confidential client** + **OpenID Connect Authorization Code Flow**. Set the redirect URI to `<your-server>/api/mcp-oauth/callback`.
2. A subscription to each sandbox API product you want to use — currently `accounting-clients v2.0`, `accounting-documents v2.0`, and `accounting-dataexchange v1`.
3. A DATEV-Konto user with SmartLogin or SmartCard/mIDentity. DATEV does NOT expose `client_credentials` — every call is on-behalf-of a human accountant. The engine records the refresh-token lifetime returned by DATEV when available; do not assume a two-year token.

**Sandbox defaults**: this adapter is pinned to `https://login.datev.de/openidsandbox/authorize`, `https://sandbox-api.datev.de/token`, and `platform-sandbox` API paths. Use this adapter for sandbox apps so catalog imports do not reset the connector back to production.

**Setup**:
1. Set `DATEV_CLIENT_ID` and `DATEV_CLIENT_SECRET` (from the DATEV portal sandbox app).
2. Import this adapter.
3. Run the one-time OAuth flow: `POST /api/connectors/{id}/oauth/authorize` → open the returned URL → log in with your DATEV-Konto → the platform stores an encrypted refresh token automatically.
4. From now on every call sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>` AND the mandatory `X-DATEV-Client-Id: <DATEV_CLIENT_ID>` header automatically.

**Scopes requested**: `openid profile email offline_access datev:accounting:clients accounting:clients:read accounting:documents datev:accounting:exchange` — scoped to just the three product lines this adapter exposes. Your DATEV sandbox app still needs the corresponding product subscriptions/permissions. The requested scopes are sent together because this connector requires all three services; DATEV remains authoritative for the consent and token type shown during authorization.

**accounting-data-exchange note**: this product's real API (per DATEV's own OpenAPI spec, v1.7.0) lives on a separate host (`accounting-data-exchange.api.datev.de`, hyphenated) with no bare `/clients` listing endpoint of its own — get `clientId` from `datev_sandbox_list_clients` instead. Job creation is per resource type (account-postings, open-items, sums-and-balances-quantity-and-weight), each with its own dedicated result-retrieval endpoint, rather than one generic jobs/result endpoint. `open-items` is marked by DATEV as under development and currently returns no data.

**Mandant scoping**: most per-client tools take a `clientId` parameter — that's the **Mandant UUID** (RFC4122 8-4-4-4-12), returned by the relevant product's client-list tool. **Distinct** from `DATEV_CLIENT_ID` (the OAuth app identifier, sent in the header).

**Not exposed here**:
- Multipart/file upload endpoints are excluded where they require binary file parts, because the REST engine does not yet support safe binary upload values.
- `accounting:dxso-jobs`, `accounting:extf-files`, MyTax, tax-transfer, and all HR/Lohn product lines (payroll reports, payroll exports, eAU, HR documents, HR exchange) were removed from this adapter to keep the sandbox scoped to what's actually released for production — see `datev.json` product-line adapters if you need to test those separately.
- The `datev_idp_next` security option (next-gen `signin.datev.de/datevam/...` IdP) is defined in the specs but not yet exposed here.

authConfig.scopes: openid profile email offline_access datev:accounting:clients accounting:clients:read accounting:documents datev:accounting:exchange

tools.name: datev_sandbox_list_clients
tools.description: List DATEV accounting Mandanten (clients) your DATEV-Konto user is provisioned for, from the accounting-clients v2 master-data product. Returns each client's UUID, consultant number, client number and display name. Use the returned UUID as the `clientId` parameter on all other tools.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_get_client
tools.description: Get one Mandant's master data (consultant/client number, name, address) from accounting-clients v2.

clientId.description: Mandant UUID (RFC4122 8-4-4-4-12). Get this from datev_sandbox_list_clients.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_documents_list_clients
tools.description: List the subset of Mandanten that have DATEV Unternehmen online (DUO) document access via the accounting-documents v2 product. This may be smaller than datev_sandbox_list_clients — only clients with active DUO subscriptions appear here.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_get_documents_client
tools.description: Get one Mandant's basic data as exposed by the accounting-documents v2 product (the DUO view, distinct from the accounting-clients master record).

tools.name: datev_sandbox_list_document_types
tools.description: List the document types (Belegtypen) configured for a Mandant on DATEV Unternehmen online — needed before uploading documents so you know which `documentType` values are accepted.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_get_duo_version
tools.description: Get the DATEV Unternehmen online (DUO) version and the permitted file extensions for document upload on a given Mandant. Useful before generating uploads to know what file formats DUO will accept (PDF, JPG, TIFF, etc.) and any DUO-version-specific limits.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years
tools.description: List the fiscal years (Wirtschaftsjahre) available for a Mandant in the Datenservice Export Rechnungswesen (accounting-data-exchange). Get the clientId from datev_sandbox_list_clients.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_fiscal_year
tools.description: Get one fiscal year's (Wirtschaftsjahr) details for a Mandant.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

fiscalYearId.description: Fiscal year ID (WirtschaftsjahresId) — an 8-digit integer, e.g. 20240101, from datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_job_state
tools.description: Get the state (pending/done/error) of any accounting-data-exchange job by its job ID, regardless of which resource type it was created for.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

jobId.description: Job ID returned when the job was created.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_create_account_postings_job
tools.description: Create an asynchronous job to retrieve Account Postings (Kontobuchungen) for a fiscal year. Returns a jobId — poll datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_job_state, then fetch the result with datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_account_postings_job.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

fiscalYearId.description: Fiscal year ID (WirtschaftsjahresId) — an 8-digit integer, e.g. 20240101, from datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years.

documentLinks.description: Include document links for each posting in the result. Default false.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_account_postings_job
tools.description: Retrieve a page of Account Postings for a completed job created by datev_sandbox_dataexchange_create_account_postings_job. The result includes a responseHeaders object with x-total-count/x-total-pages/x-current-page/x-page-size so you know when to stop paging.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

page.description: Page number (1-25000). Required by DATEV's API.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_accounting_sequences
tools.description: List the accounting sequences (Belegkreise/Buchungssequenzen) for a fiscal year.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

fiscalYearId.description: Fiscal year ID (WirtschaftsjahresId) — an 8-digit integer, e.g. 20240101, from datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_general_ledger_accounts
tools.description: List general ledger accounts (Sachkonten) for a fiscal year.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

fiscalYearId.description: Fiscal year ID (WirtschaftsjahresId) — an 8-digit integer, e.g. 20240101, from datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years.

onlyBooked.description: true: only accounts that have been booked. Default false (all captioned accounts).

includesPersonalAccounts.description: true: also include booked/captioned business-partner accounts. Default false.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_terms_of_payment
tools.description: List the terms of payment (Zahlungsbedingungen) configured for a fiscal year.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

fiscalYearId.description: Fiscal year ID (WirtschaftsjahresId) — an 8-digit integer, e.g. 20240101, from datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_agricultural_financial_statement
tools.description: Get the agricultural financial statement (landwirtschaftlicher Vermoegensvergleich) for a fiscal year, as CSV. Only available from fiscal year 20220701/20230630 onward, and only for clients using the DATEV standard chart of accounts SKR14 for agriculture and forestry (SKR14).

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

fiscalYearId.description: Fiscal year ID (WirtschaftsjahresId) — an 8-digit integer, e.g. 20240101, from datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_create_open_items_job
tools.description: Create an asynchronous job to retrieve Open Items (offene Posten) for a fiscal year. WARNING (per DATEV's own spec): this endpoint is currently under development — no data is returned yet. Poll with datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_job_state, fetch with datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_open_items_job.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

fiscalYearId.description: Fiscal year ID (WirtschaftsjahresId) — an 8-digit integer, e.g. 20240101, from datev_sandbox_dataexchange_list_fiscal_years.

isClearedType.description: OPEN_ITEM (default, only open items) or ALL (all items regardless of clearing state).

includeDocumentLink.description: Include the document link field in the result. Default false.

tools.name: datev_sandbox_dataexchange_get_open_items_job
tools.description: Retrieve a page of Open Items for a completed job created by datev_sandbox_dataexchange_create_open_items_job. WARNING (per DATEV's own spec): this endpoint is currently under development — no data is returned yet. The result includes a responseHeaders object with x-total-count/x-total-pages/x-current-page/x-page-size so you know when to stop paging.

clientId.description: DATEV client identifier in '{consultantNumber}-{clientNumber}' format (e.g. '29098-55003') — NOT the Mandant UUID used by accounting:clients/documents tools internally. This is exactly the 'id' field returned by datev_sandbox_list_clients / datev_sandbox_get_client, so pass that value through unchanged.

page.description: Page number (1-25000). Required by DATEV's API.
